newsitem.title: USA: CBOT says will open financial futures at 0850 CDT.
newsitem.headline: CBOT says will open financial futures at 0850 CDT.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said on Monday it will open trading in its financial futures contracts at 0850 CDT/1350 GMT.
The normal 0720 CDT/1220 GMT opening in contracts such as U.S. Treasury bond and note futures was delayed on Monday by unspecified telephone problems, the CBOT said.
A CBOT spokesman added that CBOT's Executive Committee said on Monday that "all trades that were made in the financial room this morning before the market was closed will be honored."

He said that CBOT notification to its trading floors that Monday's openings in financial futures would be delayed occurred simultaneously with the usual opening bell and that a few trades in five- and 10-year T-note futures apparently had occurred before trading stopped. --Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
